scenes.title: Hook: 8 billion
scenes.purpose: [hook-number] The headline figure counted up in the first second.
scenes.why: Sets the scale of the story before any chart.
on_screen_text: people on Earth on 15 November 2022, by UN estimate
scenes.visual: Counter rolls to 8,000,000,000; subline; the number shifts colour.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: The hero object persists; only its state changes.

scenes.title: Baseline: the axes
scenes.purpose: [baseline] Axis, unit and period before any data.
scenes.why: Makes the chart readable before it moves.
on_screen_text: Each billion came faster than the last.
The first billion took all of history, reached around 1804.
scenes.visual: Headline; x axis draws; year labels; gridlines at 2, 4, 6, 8; first point at 1804.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: The hero object persists; only its state changes.

scenes.title: Change: the line draws
scenes.purpose: [change] The line draws with a dot on its front.
scenes.why: Shows that each billion arrived faster than the last.
scenes.visual: Segment by segment the line draws; each billion point pops with its year.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: The hero object persists; only its state changes.

scenes.title: Compare: first step and latest
scenes.purpose: [compare] The first step against the latest on the same axis.
scenes.why: Sets the first step against the latest one.
on_screen_text: From one to two billion: 123 years. From seven to eight: 11.
scenes.visual: First segment turns red with '123 years'; last segment red with '11 years'; middle segments dim; front breathes.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: The hero object persists; only its state changes.

scenes.title: So what, and source
scenes.purpose: [so-what] The number at human scale; the source; the chart still moving.
scenes.why: Lands the takeaway with its source.
on_screen_text: average time to add each of the last four billions
scenes.visual: Chart restores; last four segments turn red one by one; stat rises; source.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.
